title: MRR ModelInvocation
description: docs/spec/01_SYSTEM_SPEC.md MRR-FR-045 ('... record model profile, prompt/configuration hash, tool calls, token usage, and response hash subject to local redaction policy') and MRR-FR-046 ('A model response MUST be treated as a proposal until domain validation accepts it'). First task of Epic E4 (task-packets/E4-T01.yaml); the thirteenth entity schema in this repository. A ModelInvocation is an auditable record of a SINGLE model call, referencing a model-profile.schema.json ModelProfile by id and pinned content hash (model_profile_hash) rather than embedding one. PROPOSAL-ONLY BY SHAPE (MRR-FR-046, AGENTS.md rule 7): this schema declares no claim_status, no verification verdict, and no authoritative-acceptance property of any kind — 'status' is the CALL's own terminal outcome, never a judgment about whether its content is true or accepted. HASH-FIRST, REDACTION-DEFAULT (MRR-FR-045, AGENTS.md rule 11): by default only prompt_config_hash/response_hash (SHA-256) are recorded; redaction_policy carries no implied default and must be stated explicitly ('hashes_only' or 'raw_permitted') — the first if/then below enforces that 'hashes_only' never coexists with a non-null raw_prompt_text/raw_response_text. TERMINAL STATUS STAYS FIVE-WAY DISTINCT: completed/refused/content_filtered/error/timed_out are never collapsed into one generic failure (AGENTS.md prohibited shortcut); the second and third if/then blocks enforce that response_hash is present if and only if status == 'completed' — 'a refused or filtered call is NOT recorded as completed and yields no response that any field marks as accepted' (task-packets/E4-T01.yaml invariant), enforced identically here and by packages/contracts/mrr/contracts/model_invocation.py's own model_validator (mirroring verification-result.schema.json's own 'enforced twice' precedent). Each tool_calls[] entry mirrors this same 'result_hash present iff status == completed' biconditional, at its own nested if/then.

model_profile_hash.description: The referenced ModelProfile's own content_hash, pinned at call time.

operation_kind.description: MRR-FR-044: this specific call's own deterministic/stochastic kind. Explicit and required — never inferred or silently defaulted.

prompt_config_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the prompt text plus the resolved configuration used for this call (MRR-FR-045's 'prompt/configuration hash').

tool_calls.description: Each entry records the tool's name plus argument/result HASHES and its own status — never a raw tool payload by default; an empty array means no tools were used.

response_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the response, present if and only if status == 'completed'.

status.description: This call's own terminal outcome — five distinct values, never collapsed into one generic failure.

redaction_policy.description: Whether raw prompt/response text may be retained alongside its hash. No implied default — must be stated explicitly.

raw_prompt_text.description: Raw prompt text, present only when redaction_policy == 'raw_permitted'.

raw_response_text.description: Raw response text, present only when redaction_policy == 'raw_permitted'.
